NewsArticle.Title: Unique Noble Garments
NewsArticle.Content:
Aisling Artists, Bards, Historians, Lorekeepers, and Philosophers each gain unique noble garments.
The garment is worn for a Double-Moon ((1 week)) for each mark of Nobility spent. Nobility is gained by [creative contests](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/contest.html) of inspiring works eligible for display in the [library](http://www.darkages.com/2000/library/temuair) and teaching at the [College.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/news/class.html)
Visit Jean in Loures to gain unique noble garments.
